newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light trade this afternoon, mainly aided by a weaker dollar, market sources said.
"All in all it was a slow day, but we saw a few trades due to the easier dollar," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $312 a tonne cif Amsterdam and April Dutch high protein soymeal traded at $321 a tonne cif, $2 down from Friday.
Afloat Malaysian palkernel expellers traded at $103 and April EU rapemeal traded 0.10 marks lower at 30.25 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
